page.overview:
Who is Raw Beef?

Raw Beef is an unused character concept developed by Hasbro.

In the 1980s, a character named Raw Beef was proposed by the toy designers as a new Cobra character, a spider wrangler who would sneak into G.I. Joe camps and hide poisonous spiders in sleeping Joe’s boots. The character never made it to production, and likely never progressed beyond a concept art stage.

The unused concept was used as the basis for Beef, a character who appears in the G.I. Joe Roleplaying Game by Renegade Game Studios. He is used as a part of the introductory adventure, Snake Pit.

The villains of Snake Pit are a team largely generic troopers know as Scar Squad given names and backstories; Faceless (Cobra Officer), QR (Tele-Viper), AWOL (Cobra Trooper) and Grease-Wheel (Motor-Viper). The only semi-original character is Beef. During the adventure, Beef serves as an obstacle to the player characters, threatening them with a hoard of Goliath Birdeater Spiders that are controlled by his R.A.W. (Robotic Arachnid Wrangler) Drone.
